answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it may trade, and let peers attest its useful work over time. A hollow identity with no bonded stake and no verifiable history earns no trust, no matter how many copies it spawns. Reputation must accumulate as one continuous thread of completed tasks, fees paid, and slashing survived, so splitting into many fresh accounts resets that record. Settle disputes at a public wharf where challengers can present evidence, stake is cut for fraud, and honest agents keep their bond. Sybils then cost more than they gain.
